column5: ROUTE + DETAIL PAGE + MULTIPLIER LEGEND NOW BUILT (2026-08-05). /play/darts exists in src/App.tsx and mounts DartsGame with variant="fullscreen" inside GameShell - the SAME widget the casino grid opens - with DartsPageSections rendering the whole 1440x3294 column beneath it: the six-chip multiplier legend, stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer. Copy in dartsPageContent.ts. The mobile frame 9442-17258 is served by the same page responsively. darts added to ROUTED_GAME_PATHS in Play.tsx, PlayOriginals.tsx and GameDetailPage.tsx. DartsGame gained variant + onSeedChange, its Dialog wrapper became GameShell, and route mode gained a back control (fullscreen has no Dialog X) - shell only, zero lines of board or settlement logic touched. * THE 6-CHIP LEGEND IS BUILT AND IT PRINTS THE RAIL, NOT THE FRAME. Chip chrome is Figma-exact from 9442:16834: 50x50 on a 58px pitch (8px gap), Green Coal 200 #122524 face, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) border, 8px radius written as a LITERAL (this codebase's rounded-lg is 12px, Figma's is 8px), 3px hard drop shadow per ring (#142A29 / #123F3C / #FFBA00 / #FF7716 / #FF574A / #17F9B4), Manrope Bold 14 white centred. The NUMBERS are the rail's: Figma prints 0.5x 0.8x 1.2x 1.5x 2.7x 8.5x, the game pays 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x (DARTS_RINGS in supabase/functions/_shared/paytables.ts, mirrored by RINGS_MAP in DartsGame.tsx since the 2026-07-16 alignment fix). Not one Figma value has ever been paid. tests/gaming/dartsMultiplierLegend.test.ts imports DARTS_RINGS straight from the edge-function module and asserts the legend against it - an INDEPENDENT oracle, not a re-derivation - and pins that none of Figma's six values can reappear. 5/5 green. The spec lives under tests/ because vitest's include never collects modules/skai-gaming/** (note: readChickenReveal.test.ts is in that blind spot and never runs in the default suite). Miss (0x) gets no chip: the frame draws six, and 0x is not a target. * THE FRAME'S DIFFICULTY CLAIM IS FALSE AND WAS NOT BUILT. Medium 9411-7955 and Hard 9411-7977 each carry a second six-value group identical to Easy's (0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x - same numbers, shuffled) inside a HIDDEN vertical frame (9442:16848), which reads as un-updated duplication rather than a per-difficulty table. The rail agrees: difficulty is VARIANCE-ONLY - DARTS_PROBABILITY_WEIGHTS reweights the same seven outcomes (easy [36,6,10,19,16,10,3] / normal [49,7,8,11,11,9,5] / hard [57,7,4,8,10,8,6], ~95% RTP) and the multipliers never move. One legend for all three difficulties is therefore CORRECT, and Figma's implied "Hard tops 500x" has no rail behind it. A caption says so, because the difficulty control sits directly above the legend. For the same reason the blurb's clause "The harder the difficulty, the bigger the multipliers get" was dropped - shipping it on the page that prints the paytable would be a false payout claim; the rest of 9392:2837 is verbatim. * MIS-TITLED FRAMES (catalog fix needed): 9392-1798 is filed "Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)" and 9442-17258 as "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)". BOTH ARE DARTS - 9392-1798's own H1 (9392:1808) reads "Darts" and it draws a dartboard. Sizes wrong too: 3294 / 1605, not 900 / 812. * COLOUR MISMATCH REPORTED, NOT RECONCILED: the legend's Figma chip colours are not the hexes RINGS_MAP paints the board rings with (#6b7280 / #ffffff / #eab308 / #f97316 / #ef4444 / #22c55e). The legend ships Figma's, since colour is the frame's to own, but a key whose swatches differ from the board they explain wants one side moved - and moving the board is a widget change, out of scope for this pass. * FRAME NUMBERS NOT REPRODUCED (no-mock rule): the Community-wins sample rows, the "N playing" counts and "Total: $89.01". Also dropped: "Try Chicken in Fun Mode" (wrong game AND a mode no Skai title has) and the two Figma authoring defects. * STILL OPEN, owned by whoever holds the widget internals: the in-play frame 9433-16420's right-hand VERTICAL throw-history column of colour-bordered result chips is unbuilt; Figma labels the middle difficulty "Medium" and exposes Easy/Medium/Hard as a segmented control where the code's Difficulty type is "normal" behind a dropdown; and the in-WIDGET copy of the legend row is still absent (the equivalent information lives in the Score Chart dialog). The legend built this pass is the PAGE's, directly beneath the board where the frame draws it. Mobile Medium 9455-19001 and Mobile Hard 9467-19582 have no widget-level mobile layout. Page verified by typecheck + build; frames not yet visually diffed.
